summary: Borr Drilling Ltd (BORR) filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of a $287 million acquisition of five premium jack-up rigs via its 50/50 joint venture BC Ventures Ltd. The rigs acquired include two Friede Goldman JU-2000E designs (Oberon and Titania FE) and three LeTourneau Super 116-C designs (Courageous, Defender, Intrepid) from Fontis Finance Ltd. The acquisition was financed with a $237 million non-recourse seller's credit (maturing January 2029, secured by a first priority lien on the rigs) and $25 million cash from each JV partner. The transaction expands Borr's owned/jointly-owned fleet to 34 rigs and strengthens its presence in Mexico. Watch for operational integration and the maturity of the seller's credit.
